overview: The Committee of the Whole met to receive a presentation and discuss a proposal from Transom Real Estate to develop city-owned parking lots in Medford Square. No formal votes were taken on the project during the meeting.

items.title: Item 25178: Medford Square Parking Lot Redevelopment Presentation
items.summary: The committee discussed a proposal by Transom Real Estate to redevelop city parking lots into a mixed-use project featuring approximately 300 housing units, an urban grocery store, and a parking garage under a 99-year lease.
